item.title: Group report totals by account and currency
item.brief: Implement the reports half of the shared currency contract: read ledger CSV on stdin; accept old CSV lacking a currency column and treat all rows as USD; validate any supplied currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency prints an error to stderr and exits 2. Output header account,currency,total_cents; sum by account and currency; sort rows by account then currency. Add/update tests and README, run python3 -m unittest, and commit in this repository. Follow the shared contract precisely.

item.title: Add currency column to ledger CSV output
item.brief: Implement the ledger half of the shared currency contract: read transactions TSV from stdin with an optional fourth currency column; default omitted currency to USD; validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters (ASCII-only); output CSV header date,account,amount_cents,currency and currency on every row. A malformed currency must print an error naming the input line number to stderr and exit 2; preserve exit status 1 for all other input errors. Add/update tests and README, run cargo test, and commit in this repository. Follow the shared contract precisely.

evidence.caption: CSV behavior changed from three columns without currency to four columns with default/supplied currency; CLI tests cover malformed-currency line number and exit status.

pr.body: `src/lib.rs` accepts an optional fourth TSV field and validates currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. `src/main.rs` emits the shared four-column header and rows, reports malformed currency with the input line number and exit status 2, and preserves exit status 1 for other input errors. `tests/ledger.rs` covers legacy and currency-bearing rows, malformed values, physical line numbering, and error exit codes. README documents the format and statuses. Verification: `cargo fmt -- --check`, `cargo test` (all passed), and `git diff --check` (passed). Assumption: when a row has multiple malformed fields, the currency validation currently takes precedence; contract does not specify precedence.
pr.summary: Added currency-aware ledger CSV output. Before: rows had three columns and no currency; now: legacy TSV rows default to USD, optional currencies are validated, and every CSV row includes currency.
